evidence_items.explanation: LaMDA comparisons connect external knowledge access with better groundedness and safety-specific training with better safety. They provide relevant intervention evidence, but neither isolate Marcus’s three concepts nor test all three claimed consequences.

evidence_items.explanation: The researchers recover and manipulate entity-state representations in BART and T5, while acknowledging their errors. This complicates an absence-based explanation but does not determine whether inadequate versions of those capabilities cause the three listed problems.

unresolved_gaps: No located study identifies the combined causal attribution across coherence, truth discrimination and harmful speech.
The proposed linguistic factors lack operational definitions that cleanly map onto the interventions studied.
Improvements from safety training or retrieval do not establish which underlying deficit caused the original failures.
